ne.instruction: नदी किनार र जोखिमयुक्त बस्तीबाट टाढा, सुरक्षित स्थानमा रहनुहोस्। जोखिमयुक्त पुल र सडक प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्। स्थानीय प्रशासन र सुरक्षा निकायको निर्देशन पालना गर्नुहोस्।

en.headline: Budhi Gandaki at Aarughat 8.43 m — above the 5.0 m danger level
en.description: DHM: Aarughat gauging station (index 445) read 8.43 m and rising at 8:40 AM on Asoj 25 (11 Oct 2026); warning level 4.5 m, danger level 5.0 m. The flood swept away the station and bridge at about 8:40 AM, so there are no further readings. It read 2.28 m at 6:00 AM and crossed the danger level at 7:50 AM.
en.instruction: Stay in safe places away from the river and risky settlements. Avoid risky bridges and roads. Follow the local administration and security agencies.

ne.headline: बुढीगण्डकी: लोक्पा–चुम्लिङ पहिरोले थुनिएको नदी फुट्यो, तटीय क्षेत्र सतर्क रहनुहोस्
ne.description: NDRRMA प्रेस नोट (२०८३/०६/२५): चुमनुब्री गाउँपालिका–६, लोक्पा र चुम्लिङ बीच ठूलो पहिरोले बुढीगण्डकी थुनियो। थुनिएको भाग फुटेर लेदोसहितको ठूलो बाढी आयो र भौतिक क्षति भयो। गोरखा, धादिङ, तनहुँ, चितवन, नवलपरासी पूर्व र पश्चिमका नदी किनार; बेनीघाटसम्म अति उच्च जोखिम, मुग्लिङसम्म उच्च सतर्कता।
ne.instruction: नदी र जोखिमयुक्त बस्तीबाट टाढा बस्नुहोस्। बहाव घटेको देखिए पनि जोखिम सकियो भन्ने नठान्नुहोस्। बाढी हेर्न नजानुहोस्। प्रहरी र स्थानीय सूचना पालना गर्नुहोस्।

en.senderName: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) — relayed by Gati
en.headline: Budhi Gandaki: river blocked by the Lokpa–Chumling landslide burst; riverside areas stay alert
en.description: NDRRMA press note (2083-06-25): a big landslide between Lokpa and Chumling in Chumnubri Rural Municipality-6 blocked the Budhi Gandaki. The blockage burst into a large debris flood and caused physical damage. River banks in Gorkha, Dhading, Tanahun, Chitwan, and Nawalparasi East and West; very high risk down to Benighat, high alert up to Mugling.
en.instruction: Stay away from the river and risky settlements. Do not assume the risk is over even if the flow looks lower. Do not go to watch the flood. Follow police and local announcements.

en.senderName: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Authority (NDRRMA) — relayed by Gati
en.headline: The Narayani River has crossed the danger level
en.description: NDRRMA, Asoj 11, 8 AM: current level 11 m (danger level 11 m); expected peak about 13.0 m. Areas: Chitwan, Nawalparasi East and Nawalparasi West. Later: Narayani at Devghat 4.17 m, steady (5 Oct 15:30 NPT, DHM), below the alert level.
en.instruction: Move to high, safe ground now. Stay away from river banks and low-lying areas.
